title: 1. Full Observability
description: L1 troubleshooting: Region → Country → Site ID → Device. Meraki and Viptela together. Leave Device = All for site view.

panels.title: Where am I — global / region / country / site
Network Health
panels.description: Explainable score. 100 HEALTHY, 80–99 WARNING, 60–79 DEGRADED, <60 CRITICAL. See Site Health Score table.

panels.title: Top problem sites
panels.description: Lowest health first. Click a site, set Site ID above, then open Inventory / Meraki / SD-WAN.

panels.title: WAN / uplink — is the site's WAN healthy right now?
Peak jitter
panels.description: Empty means the collector has no jitter sample (Meraki often omits it; Viptela AppRoute may supply it).

panels.title: WAN / uplink live view
panels.description: 1 HEALTHY / active, 0.5 READY/standby, 0 DOWN. Utilisation and quality are in the panels above.

panels.title: WAN throughput RX / TX
panels.description: TX is mirrored below the axis. Always available; no CIR required.

panels.title: Packet loss
panels.description: Meraki cloud probe and Viptela AppRoute where collected.

panels.title: SD-WAN overlay (Viptela sites in this scope)

targets.expr: 100 * sum(overlay_sessions_up{region=~"$region", country=~"$country", site_id=~"$site_id", protocol="bfd"}) / (sum(overlay_sessions_total{region=~"$region", country=~"$country", site_id=~"$site_id", protocol="bfd"}) > 0)

100 * sum(overlay_sessions_up{region=~"$region", country=~"$country", site_id=~"$site_id", protocol="omp"}) / (sum(overlay_sessions_total{region=~"$region", country=~"$country", site_id=~"$site_id", protocol="omp"}) > 0)

100 * sum(overlay_sessions_up{region=~"$region", country=~"$country", site_id=~"$site_id", protocol="bgp"}) / (sum(overlay_sessions_total{region=~"$region", country=~"$country", site_id=~"$site_id", protocol="bgp"}) > 0)

sum(overlay_sessions_total{region=~"$region", country=~"$country", site_id=~"$site_id", protocol="bfd"}) - sum(overlay_sessions_up{region=~"$region", country=~"$country", site_id=~"$site_id", protocol="bfd"})
